CustomField.description: Numeric position of the current Color Review Stage (Not Started 0 ... Complete 6). Helper for the Skipped Colors and summary formulas.
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Color_Review_Stage__c), "Pink Review",1, "Red Review",2, "Blue Review",3, "Gold Review",4, "Green Review",5, "Complete",6, 0)
CustomField.label: Color Review Stage Order
